title: Shape search G1 on its frozen cells (n, l) = (13, 5), (17, 6), (19, 7)
status_note: PR #1892 merged (3c0646ba9). Sized by the probes of 2026-10-18 and PROTOCOL.md frozen in this card directory; execution in research/shape_search_g1_frozen_cells_20261018/ on a 124 GB host (stages A, B, C of PROTOCOL.md section 3). Status left for the coordinator.
blocked_on: hw:degree-7 matrices need 47-50 GB at (13, 5) and more at (17, 6) and (19, 7) (PROTOCOL.md §3 of research/shape_search_g1_g6_20261015); size a host per cell in this card's PROTOCOL.md

notes: research/shape_search_g1_g6_20261015/README.md (merged in PR #1892; G1 killed on the scaled cells; 'not testable on the frozen cells (resource)')

question: On class-0 targets at m = 3, do the gp and fp factor-base shapes have a mean refutation degree at least 0.5 below random at two of the frozen cells (13, 5), (17, 6), (19, 7), as goal G1 was frozen to ask?
decision_value: G1 is already killed on the scaled cells (gap 0.000 at n = 5, 7, 11), so the prior is a null here too; this card exists because the frozen goal named these cells and they were not testable for resources, which leaves G1's verdict on its own terms open. A gap of >= 0.5 at two frozen cells revives the shape line and gates G6 (n = 31 with the real F4 engine, then the m = 83 gate); no gap closes G1 on its frozen cells and retires the shape builders; a censored result (both arms at the degree bound) closes nothing and says so.

resources.notes: Sized on 2026-10-18 (PROTOCOL.md section 6): (13, 5) at d_max = 6 takes 5,732 s per draw at 2.1 GB on one thread; at d_max = 7 one draw exceeds 4 h (peak 7.7 GB sampled when killed), so the 47-50 GB degree-7 estimate stands unmeasured. The ladder does not parallelise a draw. Stage A (d_max = 6, five shape processes) is about 7 wall hours; stages B and C are not estimable from completed probes.

params.argv_note: Cell syntax n:l:d_max as in runs/*.meta of the study; output is JSONL on stdout, which cairn lab exec records as the run's stdout blob. Instance and target counts and the dense budget are set in PROTOCOL.md from the probe.

outputs.result_schema: factor_base_shape_ladder g1 JSONL (one line per measured target), scored by `factor_base_shape_ladder score`

cairn.notes: Three single heavy runs, one lab task per cell. Not preemptible (no checkpoint).
